critical.issue: Ingress/edge (Cloudflare) 60s timeout returns 502 Bad Gateway for multi-implant / high-phase cases while the backend actually completes successfully at ~70s. Reproduced 3x: 4-implant proc 69f640160ae04a75cf8d0cd8 → localhost:8001 finishes in 70s with 200 + 13.2KB summary; public URL returns 502 at 60.1s. Single-implant case (699fc5c1248100e8a0d87261) also 502'd at 60.2s (variable). Root cause is the Claude primary-key ChatError adds ~2s per attempt plus the fallback generation of a 8-13KB structured document exceeds the ingress budget. This will hit real users the same way. Recommend either: (a) reduce output size by generating sections in parallel or streaming, (b) skip primary key retry when we know it's out of credit (cache the 'insufficient balance' outcome for ~5min), (c) increase ingress timeout, or (d) return 202 + poll pattern for case-summary.

minor.issue: Total user latency ~30s+ because primary Claude key always errors then fallback runs. Consider short-circuit cache of 'primary key balance exhausted' for a rolling window so every request doesn't pay the extra call+retry cost.

action_items: Fix /api/ai/case-summary 502 for multi-implant / high-phase cases at the ingress boundary (largest-impact issue).

Consider caching the 'customer Anthropic key rejected' outcome inside _claude_send for N minutes to avoid paying the extra ~2s retry cost on every single AI call (compounds to real user pain on case-summary and surgical-notes).
critical_code_review_comments: _claude_send (~L10483): 'raise last_err if last_err else RuntimeError' inside the for-loop path is fine, but the caller-facing exception is opaque (ChatError from emergentintegrations). Consider wrapping to a domain-specific AIError with the last provider message so ai_assistant's friendly-error path can surface something more informative than 'debug: ChatError'.

Because the primary ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is known to be zero-balance today, every text-AI call pays a full round-trip + retry (~2-4s wasted per call). A short-lived (5-15 min) in-memory 'this key is broken' cache would remove this constant overhead and would have kept /api/ai/case-summary on multi-implant cases under the 60s ingress budget in this test run.

server.py is 22,601 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline. iter-404 refactor was clean (shared _claude_send + persona constants), but this monolith should be split module by module (ai/, procedures/, auth/, catalog/, phases/) for future maintainability.

rca of the issue: PRIMARY: /api/ai/case-summary 502 via public URL. RCA: (1) Customer's ANTHROPIC_API_KEY has $0 balance so _claude_send always fails on key #1 (ChatError, ~2s) and retries on EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. (2) EMERGENT key succeeds on Claude Sonnet 4.6 but generating a phase-aware 8–13KB structured summary takes ~50–70s wall-clock. (3) Ingress (Cloudflare/K8s) has a hard 60s upstream timeout, so any case whose generation exceeds ~58s returns a Cloudflare 502 to the caller while the backend actually returned 200 to the socket a few seconds later. Reproduction: POST /api/ai/case-summary with procedure_id=69f640160ae04a75cf8d0cd8 (4-implant case) via https://dental-consent-sign.preview.emergentagent.com → 502 at 60.1s consistently. Same procedure via http://localhost:8001 → 200 with 13,272-char summary at ~70s. Mitigation: (a) cache 'ANTHROPIC key exhausted' outcome so we skip the wasted ~2s primary attempt, (b) parallelise per-phase section generation (each phase is independent), (c) stream sections back with SSE, or (d) switch case-summary to a 202+poll pattern with a background task.
